visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women with long dark hair stand side-by-side against a white textured wall featuring black graffiti that reads 'Big dreams.' They wear oversized black hoodies with red heart graphics. They look directly at the camera with neutral expressions before reaching up to pull their hoods over their heads in unison. (2) The scene shifts to a slightly higher angle as they pose with their hands pulling the tops of their hoods into pointed cat-ear shapes. They smile warmly, standing in a paved alleyway with a vintage light-blue scooter parked in the background. The lighting is bright and even natural daylight. (3) A series of quick cuts shows them in various playful photography poses. An external hand reaches into the frame to pull the center of their hoods upward as they press their heads together, giggling. They transition into different formations, pulling the hood strings tight to frame their faces in comical ways. (4) Close-up shots highlight their facial expressions—smiling, winking, and squinting—while they experiment with hood-pulling techniques. One woman makes a 'claws' gesture with her hands in a low-angle shot. The final shot shows them standing confidently with hands on hips, hoods down, smiling broadly at the camera lens.
